tasks.title: Add dueDateStatus computed helper to src/utils/taskHelpers.js
tasks.description: Computed helper that takes a task object and returns null | approaching | overdue based on dueDate vs today
acceptance_criteria: Returns null when no dueDate or dueDate > 2 days away
Returns approaching when dueDate is within 2 days (including today)
Returns overdue when dueDate is in the past

tasks.title: Add due date badge to TaskCard.vue
tasks.description: Show colored chip/badge based on dueDateStatus: yellow Due soon, red Overdue, or no chip
acceptance_criteria: Yellow chip with text Due soon when approaching
Red chip with text Overdue when past due
No chip when dueDateStatus is null

tasks.title: Add CSS styling for the two badge states using Nextcloud theming variables
tasks.description: Style the approaching and overdue badges using Nextcloud CSS custom properties
acceptance_criteria: Badge colors use Nextcloud theming CSS variables

tasks.title: Add unit test for dueDateStatus helper
tasks.description: Cover all boundary conditions: no due date, future, approaching, today, past
acceptance_criteria: Test no due date returns null
Test future date >2 days returns null
Test approaching date 1-2 days returns approaching
